changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case_order_detail ALTER COLUMN antibiotic_exposure TYPE BOOLEAN USING CASE WHEN antibiotic_exposure IS NULL OR trim(antibiotic_exposure) = '' THEN NULL WHEN lower(trim(antibiotic_exposure)) IN ('false', 'f', 'no', 'n', '0') THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END

ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case_order_detail ALTER COLUMN critical_notification_preference TYPE BOOLEAN USING CASE WHEN critical_notification_preference IS NULL OR trim(critical_notification_preference) = '' THEN NULL WHEN lower(trim(critical_notification_preference)) IN ('false', 'f', 'no', 'n', '0') THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case_order_detail ALTER COLUMN antibiotic_exposure TYPE TEXT USING CASE WHEN antibiotic_exposure IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN antibiotic_exposure THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END

ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_case_order_detail ALTER COLUMN critical_notification_preference TYPE VARCHAR(255) USING CASE WHEN critical_notification_preference IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN critical_notification_preference THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END
